title: Biosynthesis of Pseudomonas aeruginosa mediated silver nanoparticles for remediation of crude oil contaminated water

This study was aimed at biosynthesizing silver nanoparticle (AgNP) for remediation of total petroleum hydrocarbon (TPH) from crude oil-contaminated water samples from Nigeria's Niger-Delta ecosystem.
